LEVER (b), s500p perf round 37 (RUNTIME-ONLY).  %p-collect-list (map/grep/sort/reverse's argument collector) started every result at 8 slots and grew it; p-grep's own result started at 0.

PROFILE LINES (s500p Step 0, main 209e7533): 1013-Permutation-test: %p-collect-list 20.5 % total, extend-vector 11.4 %, prepare-vector-push-extend 13.6 %, reallocate-vector-with-widetag 6.6 % (`grep $_, @$pattern` in scalar context, twice per iteration).  Also Derangements 11 %, Vampire 9 %, Summarize 6.6 % in extend-vector.

FIX: %p-collect-list-size counts what the items spread to (exact for every shape but a raw %hash, estimated as 2 x hash-table-count) and the result is allocated at that size; p-grep's result is allocated at the input's length.

SIZED (interleaved best-of-7, control pair +/-1.6 %, load 1.5-3.5, scratch/s500p/sizing-b2.txt): Permutation-test 1.290 -> 1.169 s (-9.3 %); m-grep micro -20 %; Derangements, Vampire, Summarize flat (their extend-vector is elsewhere).
